description: "I have €500, I'm flying from Madrid, anywhere is fine": finds destinations whose recently seen round-trip fare leaves enough of the budget for the hotel. For each: the fare, the money left per night for a hotel, flight and hotel booking links, and how many verified food spots from TikTok/Instagram food videos GeoTok already has there. Fares are cached prices seen recently, not live quotes; hotel prices are not included — the figure is the budget left per night.

budget.description: Total budget for flights + hotel, for all travellers together.

depart_date.description: Exact departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. Use this or 'month'.

month.description: Flexible: any departure in this month, YYYY-MM.

origin.description: Departure city or airport (name or IATA code), e.g. 'Madrid'.

name: find_trips_on_budget
title: Trips anywhere on a budget
